description: docs/STATUS.md mentions the current bead-id (under Drafted, Shipped, or Pending follow-ups)
run: BEAD=$(cat .rsry-bead-id 2>/dev/null); test -n "$BEAD" || { echo 'no .rsry-bead-id to check against'; exit 0; }; grep -qF "$BEAD" docs/STATUS.md || { echo "STATUS.md does not mention $BEAD — add a row under Drafted, Pending follow-ups, or move to Shipped on merge"; exit 1; }
